endorsements.quote: this model ensures that the system’s responses do not contain inappropriate content, do not provide medical advice beyond the SP role, and do not respond to learners in educationally unsuitable ways.
establishing a regular review mechanism involving medical humanities experts and cross-cultural communication researchers to sample and evaluate the appropriateness of AI-SP responses
Do learners have the right to access or delete their own data?
At the management level, establish an “anonymized storage+tiered access+log tracking” protection mechanism with differentiated access permissions.
It is recommended to start with elective courses or extracurricular practice, accumulate evidence, and then gradually integrate it into required courses.
anomaly reporting: the system automatically flags potentially problematic interactions (eg, involving unsafe medical advice) for teacher review

unlisted_practices: Provide learners clear informed-consent explanations before first use of AI-SP, specifying data usage, retention period, dissemination restrictions, and data destruction procedures.
Maintain educator oversight and intervention capacity, including periodic content audits, until AI-SP safety and effectiveness are fully validated.
Use retrieval-augmented generation to constrain AI-SP responses within preapproved clinical knowledge bases to reduce hallucination.
Introduce dialogue state tracking and teacher spot-check validation during initial deployment to ensure consistent personality and emotional responses.
Use AI-SP only under supervision as a supplement and preparation tool for real patient contact, not as a replacement.
Prioritize human review for high-risk or culturally sensitive AI-SP scenarios such as reproductive decisions or end-of-life care.
Provide learner feedback channels to flag unrealistic or potentially problematic AI-SP responses.
Adapt AI-SP design to local cultural communication norms rather than replicating Western models.
Evaluate AI-SP effectiveness empirically using a structured framework such as Kirkpatrick's four levels.
Provide low-threshold training workshops and involve teachers in scenario design to address educator resistance to AI-SP.
